original_P1: External same-invocation sealed prefix is within the requested correction scope and covers actual cache/resource reads, but these implementation gaps prevent closure acceptance.

findings.problem: The full exec-through-barrier trace necessarily includes load_bound opening args.closure before the hook. check_startup_trace requires this ordinary file in entries, while the existing control_read_paths contract intentionally keeps the same manifest outside entries because it cannot embed its own hash. No authenticated control-read mapping is passed to reconciliation, so legitimate master/RED/GREEN startup rejects.
findings.evidence: Pure actual check_startup_trace rejects unlisted /control/closure.json; source main always performs the read before the barrier. This is not an observed full handshake.
findings.minimal_correction: Carry exact already same-buffer-authenticated closure path/digest as a separate explicit control-read binding into reconciliation and audit as needed. Revalidate that specific identity; do not require self-hashing or silently skip arbitrary control paths.
required_regressions: Positive source-bound startup prefix includes the real authenticated closure read without a self-entry.
Changed closure bytes/hash or an extra undeclared ordinary read rejects; preserve complete unabridged prefix and per-process context bindings.

findings.problem: Relative readlinkat ignores its annotated directory FD and resolves against process cwd. A valid trace readlinkat(3</actual/dir>,"alias",...) is accepted with only /cwd/alias declared; consumed /actual/dir/alias remains unlisted.
findings.evidence: Pure parser counterexample recorded in reconcile-results.json; file-digest I/O seam only, no complete runtime acceptance claimed.
findings.minimal_correction: Resolve readlinkat relative paths using AT_FDCWD or the actual annotated dirfd, consistently with openat, or fail closed for an unsupported form. Do not substitute cwd for a non-AT_FDCWD descriptor.
required_regressions: Non-AT_FDCWD relative readlinkat rejects when actual link path is undeclared even if same basename exists in cwd.
Correctly declared actual link with literal target passes; missing/unresolved dirfd fails closed.

root_prerequisites_unchanged: Actual tracer/PID namespace association and root-protected live prefix/sealing protocol
Readonly input/evidence mounts and exact tool/loader/provider closure
Full actual original interpreter/image startup/import/collection within original bounded gate
